name: Thirsty
source:
The plot begins with a basic human need: thirst. You need water. All the stores are closed, and it’s late at night. 

What will your path be?

[From [url=https://deadbobel.itch.io/thirsty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
情节始于人类的基本需求：口渴。你需要水。所有的商店都关门了，已经是深夜了。

你的道路将是什么？

[来自[url=https://deadbobel.itch.io/thirsty]Itch.io[/url]]
